runName.title: Run name
runName.description: Optional label for this run. Any text is allowed, including spaces, symbols, accents and emoji (e.g. "Denver integrators – Batch #3 (Sept '26) ✅"). Saved on every result row and in the RUN_SUMMARY record.

urls.title: Website URLs
urls.description: Websites to check, one per line. URLs without https:// are fixed automatically.

geminiApiKey.title: Gemini API key
geminiApiKey.description: Used for summaries and to confirm brand-only sites. Falls back to the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.

maxSubpages.title: Max subpages per site
maxSubpages.description: Internal pages to fetch after the homepage.

skipOnGeminiNo.title: SKIP brand-only sites when Gemini says no
skipOnGeminiNo.description: Off: these stay MAYBE (low). On: they become SKIP.
